description: This file defines the Popup_Picker class, which manages the display and processing of a popup interface for selecting employee records within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for generating search filters, rendering the popup HTML, and handling user interactions for selecting employees.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and handling an employee selection popup interface in SuiteCRM, including search query handling and list rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the Popup_Picker class.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause based on search parameters provided in the request.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the popup page, including search form and employee list.
